rca_of_issues.original_issue: User reported that when receiving a video call from chat, only the 'Jetzt beitreten' button appeared in chat instead of a foreground modal
rca_of_issues.root_cause: IncomingCallModal was not rendered via Portal and had lower z-index, causing it to be hidden behind other UI elements or not escape stacking contexts
